{{Quote|Arriving starships must approach Dulin starport from the southern approach vector. The northern approach vector will be temporarily closed from 2500 to 2700 hours for a fireworks display as part of the city's celebration of the New Year Fete Week. '''Dulin starport'''<ref name="Platt" /> was located in<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=Dulin [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]]|system=[[Dulin system/Legends|Dulin system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Dulin system/Legends|Dulin system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
